scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Talk to Eriuous in the Prontera Pub. He asks you deliver a message to his lost love, Elly.
1.short_ru: Поговорите с Eriuous в Prontera о сообщении для Elly.
1.short_en: Talk to Eriuous in Prontera about the message for Elly.
1.full_ru: Поговорите с Eriuous в трактире Prontera. Он попросит доставить сообщение его пропавшей возлюбленной Elly.
1.full_en: Talk to Eriuous in the Prontera Pub. He asks you deliver a message to his lost love, Elly.

2.original_instruction: Find Billik in Umbala ( umbala 216, 182) and he will tell you about someone in the City of the Dead, aka Nifflheim .
2.full_ru: Найдите Billik в Umbala (umbala 216, 182). Он расскажет о ком-то в City of the Dead, то есть Nifflheim.
2.full_en: Find Billik in Umbala ( umbala 216, 182) and he will tell you about someone in the City of the Dead, aka Nifflheim .

3.original_instruction: Talk to Feylin ( niflheim 152, 215). After talking to him several times he will try to make contact with the one you're searching for, but he'll need 10 Yggdrasil Leaf . When two options appear do not choose Sorry otherwise he will NOT talk to you. | Note: You must bring a Witherless Rose to get Feylin to talk to you.
3.short_ru: Принесите Feylin в niflheim 152, 215 Witherless Rose и 10 Yggdrasil Leaf; не выбирайте Sorry.
3.short_en: Bring Feylin at niflheim 152, 215 Witherless Rose and 10 Yggdrasil Leaf; do not choose Sorry.
3.full_ru: Поговорите с Feylin (niflheim 152, 215) несколько раз. Он попробует связаться с тем, кого вы ищете, но ему потребуются 10 Yggdrasil Leaf. Когда появятся два варианта, не выбирайте Sorry, иначе он НЕ станет с вами разговаривать. Примечание: чтобы Feylin начал разговор, нужно принести Witherless Rose.
3.full_en: Talk to Feylin ( niflheim 152, 215). After talking to him several times he will try to make contact with the one you're searching for, but he'll need 10 Yggdrasil Leaf . When two options appear do not choose Sorry otherwise he will NOT talk to you. | Note: You must bring a Witherless Rose to get Feylin to talk to you.

items.condition: Must be brought to initiate conversation; count/removal timing not established.
Material request for summoning; consumed total is separately in the source header.

options.condition: Avoid; source says he will not talk afterward. Correct alternative text is not printed.

4.original_instruction: Depending on how things turn out, he'll either succeed or fail at summoning Elly. | If he fails, you will lose most of your HP.
4.short_ru: Дождитесь результата вызова Elly; при неудаче возможна большая потеря HP.
4.short_en: Wait for the Elly summoning result; failure causes major HP loss.
4.full_ru: В зависимости от исхода ему либо удастся вызвать Elly, либо нет. При неудаче вы потеряете большую часть HP.
4.full_en: Depending on how things turn out, he'll either succeed or fail at summoning Elly. | If he fails, you will lose most of your HP.

5.original_instruction: Talk to Erious again. He asks if you met Elly. Choose either answer. | If Feylin succeeded, you will be given 10 Yggdrasil Leaf , 3 Yggdrasil Seed , and 2 Yggdrasilberry . | If Feylin failed, you will be given 10 Yggdrasil Leaf .
5.short_ru: Вернитесь к Erious: награда зависит от результата Feylin, ответ можно выбрать любой.
5.short_en: Return to Erious: the reward depends on Feylin's result; either answer is allowed.
5.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Erious. Он спросит, встретили ли вы Elly: можно выбрать любой ответ. Если Feylin удалось её вызвать, вы получите 10 Yggdrasil Leaf, 3 Yggdrasil Seed и 2 Yggdrasilberry. Если Feylin потерпел неудачу, получите 10 Yggdrasil Leaf.
5.full_en: Talk to Erious again. He asks if you met Elly. Choose either answer. | If Feylin succeeded, you will be given 10 Yggdrasil Leaf , 3 Yggdrasil Seed , and 2 Yggdrasilberry . | If Feylin failed, you will be given 10 Yggdrasil Leaf .

reviews.detail: Witherless Rose is consumed in the header and required for conversation in the body, but quantity/removal timing is not printed. Do not invent a count or per-attempt rose consumption.

Both final answers are allowed, with no exact text printed. Rewards depend on summoning success/failure, not a fabricated answer. Ten consumed leaves and ten granted leaves are different roles, not zero cost or two simultaneous grants.
Eriuous and Erious are source spellings of the initial/return interlocutor in this single quest. No Pub coordinate, HP percentage, irreversible lockout duration or summoning probability is invented.
